name: topdown-kit
description: Reusable building blocks for tile-based top-down games: an Entity struct, camera-follow smoothing, chase AI, and damage/kill/nearest-target helpers - the boilerplate Moonwell and every game like it hand-rolls from scratch.

snippets.label: Top-down kit (entities, camera, chase AI, damage)
snippets.description: Entity/Camera struct types plus cameraFollow(), chaseStep(), hit()/tickHurt() and nearestIndex() functions. Paste near the top of a #html game, after your sprites, and adapt the Entity fields to your own game.
